title: Great time
text: Luis was a great driver. We got to tour the church and see the Black Madonna. The funicular to go up the mountain (17 euros per person) and the entry to the museum (12 euros per person) are not included in the tour, but are worth paying. Lunch is also not included. Our tour also included a tour of the El Cep winery and a tasting of their delicious cavas. We had a very fun day. Luis picked us up at our hotel at 9am and got us back around 6:00 pm.
author: Anik_M

title: Great tour!
text: We had an amazing experience with Alba as our tour guide! She was so much fun, incredibly knowledgeable, and made the entire tour enjoyable from start to finish. You could tell she genuinely loves what she does, and her enthusiasm made the experience even more special. We learned so much while having a great time! We couldn’t have asked for a better guide. Highly recommend Alba to anyone taking this tour! Thank you, Alba, for such a wonderful experience!

title: When in Monserrat, book Alba!

title: Private Tour
text: Thank you Xavi for a great day. We were picked up at the hotel and driven first to a winery. Had a tour and tastings. Bought some to send home. After that we went to Montserrat for lunch and visit to the Basilica.  We rode the train up but was also given the option to go by cable car.  Highly recommend the private tour. You can go your own pace and see and do what you like!  We were a group of four and had an enjoyable day.
